CREATE TABLE ingestion_metrics (
	minute TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	count BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (minute, kind), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ingestion_count CHECK (count >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE telemetry_outbox (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	key_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sequence_number BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(12) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	available_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	lease_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	claim_token VARCHAR(36), 
	delivered_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_error VARCHAR(80), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_outbox_identity UNIQUE (device_id, key_epoch, sequence_number), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_outbox_status CHECK (status IN ('pending','claimed','delivered','dead')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_outbox_numbers CHECK (attempts >= 0 AND key_epoch > 0 AND sequence_number > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_outbox_payload CHECK (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object' AND octet_length(payload::text) <= 8192)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_outbox_ready ON telemetry_outbox (status, available_at, lease_until)
CREATE INDEX ix_outbox_retention ON telemetry_outbox (status, delivered_at)
